title: Connect a Synthetic Monitoring check to its service

blocks.content: Connect a check to its service so its monitoring results have service context in Knowledge Graph.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.content: Use an existing check you can edit and a service already discovered by an activated Knowledge Graph integration. Keep any existing correct service connection and unrelated labels.
Open your check list to choose an existing check.
Open **Checks** to choose the check that monitors your service.
blocks.tooltip: Start with the check whose results you want to connect to service context.

blocks.content: You can now choose the check whose service context you want to investigate.
Identify the service this check monitors, save the connection, and inspect the resulting relationship.

blocks.title: Connect a Synthetic Monitoring check to its service

blocks.content: Find an existing check that monitors the intended service and choose its **Edit** control yourself.
blocks.tooltip: Choose the check you own that actually monitors this service.

blocks.content: Open **Labels** to review the check’s service connection.
blocks.tooltip: Review the labels used to connect this check to service context.

blocks.content: Under **Knowledge Graph connections**, select **Add connection**; if the correct service is already connected, skip this step and the next one.
blocks.tooltip: Start a new association only when the intended service is not already connected.

blocks.content: Choose **Service** to add the service connection fields; skip this step if the service fields are already present.
blocks.tooltip: Add the fields that identify the monitored service.

blocks.content: Choose the discovered service that this check monitors in **Service name**, or keep an existing correct value.
blocks.tooltip: Match the service actually monitored by this check and preserve an existing correct value.

blocks.content: Choose the matching **Namespace**, preserving an existing correct value; use **Any namespace** only for an intentionally unscoped service.
blocks.tooltip: Match the namespace to distinguish this service from services with the same name elsewhere.

blocks.content: Review the service and namespace, then select **Save** to persist the connection labels.
blocks.tooltip: Persist the reviewed values while keeping unrelated labels intact.

blocks.content: After saving, allow several minutes for the relationship to appear. On the check dashboard, confirm that **Connected entities** shows the service and namespace you selected.
blocks.tooltip: Confirm that the displayed relationship matches the service this check monitors.

blocks.content: The saved service name and namespace connect this check to the service you verified in the graph.
